name: BPPA tender notices (Govt)
note: Government tender advertisements (Goods, Works, Services, Physical services) from bppa.gov.bd, with procurement method (OTM/LTM...), funding partner (ADB/JICA/World Bank...) and closing time. First run reads the newest ~320 and 60 detail pages; later runs fill in the rest.

name: e-GP eTenders list (Govt)
note: The public e-GP tender list, read with a headless browser (login-free part only, no CAPTCHA). If it fails, data/egp_debug.txt in the repository shows what the browser saw.

name: World Bank (Bangladesh)
note: Public API. Bids, EOIs and prequalification for World Bank funded projects. Contract awards skipped. Free, no key.

name: Asian Development Bank
note: Experimental. Most ADB funded Bangladesh contracts are also advertised through e-GP/BPPA and tagged 'ADB' there.

name: JICA Bangladesh Office
focus: procurement, tender, bidding or consultant selection
note: Experimental. JICA funded works are procured through e-GP and appear there tagged 'JICA'.

name: BRAC e-Tender
note: BRAC's tender list is built by JavaScript, so it is opened in a headless browser, then read by AI.

name: Islami Bank Bangladesh
note: Table of tender notices with last dates and PDF links. Runtime robots.txt check applies.

name: Meghna Bank
note: General notice board; most items are tenders/RFPs. Pages 1-2 cover the newest notices.

name: Uttara Bank
note: Tender page linked from the bank's Media Room menu; layout not verified.

name: e-GP (daily RSS)
note: Switched off: the RSS feeds returned nothing. Replaced by 'egp-list' and 'bppa-govt' below. Set enabled to true to retry.

name: e-GP (weekly RSS)
note: Switched off: the RSS feeds returned nothing. Replaced by 'egp-list' and 'bppa-govt' below. Set enabled to true to retry.

name: The Daily Star (e-paper)
note: Tender ads are inside e-paper pages. Open the homepage, find the direct image/PDF URL of a tender page, replace the date and page number in it with {yyyy} {mm} {dd} {page}, list the page numbers that carry tenders in 'pages', then enable. Or paste page URLs into inbox.txt.

name: The Daily Observer (e-paper)
note: Same steps as the Daily Star entry.

name: Newspaper name (e-paper)
note: Copy this block for each newspaper (Prothom Alo, Bangladesh Pratidin, Ittefaq, Jugantor, Samakal, Financial Express, New Age, Dhaka Tribune, Sangbad and so on). Dates use Bangladesh time.
